method: Per-pixel Theil-Sen slope + Mann-Kendall test (tie-corrected, lag-1 autocorrelation variance inflation), Benjamini-Hochberg FDR alpha 0.10; cos(latitude) area weighting.
disclaimers: Trend detection and anomaly alerts only; no forecasts.
Reanalysis and model products are labelled as such; they are not site measurements.

variables.name: solar_irradiance
caveats: POWER's 1984-present solar series splices SRB (to 2000) and SYN1deg (from 2001) with a +1.5% step; not used for trends. See docs/sources.md.
variables.method: Theil-Sen slope; Mann-Kendall (tie-corrected, lag-1 autocorrelation-adjusted: True); Benjamini-Hochberg FDR alpha=0.1; per-pixel annual mean

caveats: Built from DAILY mean speeds; sub-daily variability is not captured.
variables.method: Theil-Sen slope; Mann-Kendall (tie-corrected, lag-1 autocorrelation-adjusted: True); Benjamini-Hochberg FDR alpha=0.1; per-pixel annual mean

variables.name: wind_power_density
variables.long_name: Wind power density proxy (0.5 * rho * mean daily v^3)
caveats: Uses the monthly mean of DAILY v^3. Cubing monthly-mean speed instead underestimated it by 29% (median) and changed the 2010-2019 trend (-0.96 vs -0.65 %/yr) in a Great Plains test box; daily is still lower than an hourly-based value.
Proxy only; dry-air density, ignores humidity and turbine characteristics.

Daymet is on a 1 km Lambert conformal grid and needs reprojection.
